'''Volker Arzt''' (born 1941) is a German qualified physicist, [[Science journalism|science journalist]], television presenter and author.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Volker Arzt |url=https://www.penguin.de/Autor/Volker-Arzt/p3713.rhd |access-date=2023-10-14 |website=Penguin Random House Verlagsgruppe |language=de}}</ref>

== Life ==
Volker Arzt studied in [[Stuttgart]], among other places. Arzt became known in the 1970s through the [[ZDF]] series Querschnitt, which he presented together with [[Hoimar von Ditfurth]]. In the shows Die Balance der Biosphäre (The Balance of the Biosphere) and Kippt das Klima-Gleichgewicht (Is the Climate Balance Tipping?), he described the man-made [[Climate crisis|climate catastrophe]] – caused by man's use of coal, [[Petroleum|oil]] and natural gas, and warned of its [[Effects of climate change|consequences]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Querschnitt – Der Ast, auf dem wir sitzen |url=https://www.zdf.de/uri/923ef024-1004-4114-82ba-b9ec7d32f206 |access-date=2023-10-14 |website=www.zdf.de |language=de}}</ref>

Arzt was the editorial director of [[GEO (magazine)|GEO-Film]] from 1984 to 1990 and has been working as a freelance author since 1990, primarily for [[ZDF]]. Together with Immanuel Birmelin, he wrote ''Do Animals Have Consciousness?'' (1993).<ref>{{Cite web |title=Haben Tiere ein Bewußtsein? Wenn Affen lügen, wenn Katzen denken und Elefanten traurig sind |url=https://www.spektrum.de/magazin/haben-tiere-ein-bewusstsein-wenn-affen-luegen-wenn-katzen-denken-und-elefanten-traurig-sind/822013 |access-date=2023-10-14 |website=www.spektrum.de |language=de}}</ref>

== Honors ==
He has received numerous national and international awards for his television documentaries, including the [[European Environmental Prize]], the Canadian "Rocky", the Japan Award, the "Nautilus" in bronze, silver and gold, as well as the best science film at the [[Green Screen film festival|GREEN SCREEN]] Eckernförde International Nature Film Festival. In 2009, Volker Arzt received the Görlitz Meridian Nature Film Prize for his entire film work.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2016-03-04 |title=SENCKENBERG world of biodiversity {{!}} Senckenberg Gesellschaft.. {{!}} Kommunikation {{!}} Presse {{!}} Archiv alt {{!}} 2009 {{!}} 09-08-19_PM_Filmpreis Vo.. |url=https://www.senckenberg.de/root/index.php?page_id=4688 |access-date=2023-10-14 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304050332/https://www.senckenberg.de/root/index.php?page_id=4688 |archive-date=2016-03-04 }}</ref> In 2018, he received the [[Heinz Sielmann]] Film Prize for ''Surprise Eggs'' at the GREEN SCREEN Festival.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-08-07 |title=Film-Detail |url=https://www.greenscreen-festival.de/rueckblick/2018/d/show/ueberraschungseier/ |access-date=2023-10-14 |website=Green Screen Naturfilmfestival |language=de}}</ref>
